tool_input.command:
python -c "
import hopsworks, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()
q = '''
SELECT t.row_id, t.account_id, t.event_time,
       t.amount * f.fx_rate AS amount_usd,
       CASE WHEN MOD(FLOOR(t.event_time/86400000)+4, 7) IN (0,6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_weekend,
       (SELECT SUM(t2.amount) FROM \`transactions_raw48dc48_1\` t2
         WHERE t2.account_id = t.account_id
           AND t2.event_time BETWEEN t.event_time - 604800000 AND t.event_time) AS amount_7d
FROM \`transactions_raw48dc48_1\` t
JOIN \`fx_rates_raw48dc48_1\` f ON t.currency = f.currency
'''
df = fs.sql(q, online=True)
df['event_time'] = df['event_time'].astype('int64')
df['is_weekend'] = df['is_weekend'].astype('int64')
df['amount_usd'] = df['amount_usd'].astype('float64')
df['amount_7d'] = df['amount_7d'].astype('float64')
df = df[['row_id','account_id','event_time','amount_usd','is_weekend','amount_7d']]
print('computed rows:', len(df))

fg = fs.create_feature_group('features48dc48', version=1,
    description='Derived features: amount_usd, is_weekend, amount_7d',
    primary_key=['row_id'], event_time='event_time', online_enabled=True)
fg.insert(df)
print('INSERTED into features48dc48 v1:', len(df))
print('columns:', [f.name for f in fg.features])
print('online_enabled:', fg.online_enabled)
" 2>&1 | grep -viE "^202|INFO:|Uploading|Reading|%\|" | grep -v "^$"

python -c "
import hopsworks, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()
fg = fs.get_feature_group('features48dc48', version=1)
print('name/version:', fg.name, fg.version)
print('online_enabled:', fg.online_enabled, '| primary_key:', fg.primary_key, '| event_time:', fg.event_time)
print('features:', [f.name for f in fg.features])
# read back via online store
df = fs.sql('SELECT * FROM \`features48dc48_1\`', online=True)
print('online rowcount:', len(df))
print(df.sort_values('row_id').head(4).to_string())
print('weekend total:', int(df['is_weekend'].sum()), '| nulls:', df.isnull().sum().sum())
# real-time single-key lookup
try:
    fg.init_serving() if hasattr(fg,'init_serving') else None
except Exception as e:
    pass
" 2>&1 | grep -viE "^202|INFO:" | grep -v "^$"
